class.name: CgameTerrainEditLayers
class.brief_description: Chunked, non-destructive terrain editing core with layers, brushes, material splat, undo and chunk meshes.
class.description: [CgameTerrainEditLayers] is a native port of the GDScript [code]terrain_edit_layers.gd[/code] library. It keeps a base heightfield of [code]width x height[/code] texels (index [code]y * width + x[/code]) that is never modified, and an ordered stack of edit layers that store a height delta and an alpha per texel. Layers are composited over the base heights with a [enum Blend] mode, visibility and opacity. A chunk covers [code]chunk_size[/code] cells: chunk [code](cx, cz)[/code] spans texels [code]cx * chunk_size[/code] to [code]cx * chunk_size + chunk_size[/code] inclusive, so neighbouring chunks share a seam row and column. Exported heights add a one-texel border for seamless normals. Brush strokes ([method apply_brush], [method paint_splat]) and fills ([method fill_layer_rect]) are recorded on a memory-bounded undo stack. Layer property changes (visibility, opacity, blend, order) and the direct write API ([method set_layer_texel], [method write_layer_region]) are not. Every change marks the affected chunks dirty ([method take_dirty_chunks]) and queues them for collision rebuilds ([method collision_jobs]). [b]Per-texel delta API:[/b] editor tools that generate layer content themselves (for example erosion or spline stamps) use [method add_layer_from_region], [method write_layer_region], [method set_layer_texel], [method get_layer_region_deltas] and [method get_layer_region_alphas] instead of touching internal storage. These methods keep the layer bounds and dirty chunks consistent. Large composites are evaluated row by row on the [WorkerThreadPool] without affecting the result. [codeblock] var edit := CgameTerrainEditLayers.new() edit.setup(129, 129, 32, base_heights) var layer := edit.add_layer("sculpt") edit.apply_brush(layer, CgameTerrainEditLayers.BRUSH_RAISE, Vector2(40, 40), 8.0, 2.0) for chunk in edit.take_dirty_chunks(): mesh_instance.mesh = edit.build_chunk_mesh(chunk, 1.0) [/codeblock]

method.name: add_layer
method.description: Adds an empty layer on top of the stack and returns its id. Returns [code]-1[/code] if [method setup] has not been called.

method.name: add_layer_from_region
method.description: Adds a layer and fills [param rect] with the row-major [param delta] and [param alpha] values (see [method write_layer_region]). The initial content is not on the undo stack.

method.name: apply_brush
method.description: Applies a height brush to one layer and returns the changed texel rectangle, or an empty [Rect2i] if nothing changed. [param target_height] is used by [constant BRUSH_FLATTEN], [param seed_value] by [constant BRUSH_NOISE]. If [param curve] is set it replaces [param falloff]. The stroke is added to the undo stack.

method.name: build_chunk_mesh
method.description: Builds the chunk's mesh in chunk-local space (origin at the chunk's minimum corner). Normals use the exported border so lighting is continuous across seams. The colour array carries the first four splat weights when splat is set up. An invalid chunk returns an empty mesh.

method.name: can_redo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is an undone edit that can be redone.

method.name: can_undo
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there is an edit that can be undone.

method.name: chunk_count
method.description: Returns [code]chunks_x * chunks_z[/code].

method.name: collision_jobs
method.description: Pops up to [param max_per_frame] distinct chunks that need a collision rebuild, oldest first. Re-dirtied chunks are queued again.

method.name: composite_height
method.description: Returns the composited height at a texel. Coordinates are clamped to the map.

method.name: composite_region
method.description: Returns composited heights for [param rect] clipped to the map, row-major with the clipped width per row.

method.name: export_chunk_heights
method.description: Returns the chunk's heights with a one-texel border: [code](chunk_size + 3)^2[/code] values, row-major. Index [code](i, j)[/code] is texel [code](cx * chunk_size - 1 + i, cz * chunk_size - 1 + j)[/code]; out-of-map texels clamp to the edge. An invalid chunk returns an empty array.

method.name: fill_layer_rect
method.description: Writes [param delta] and [param alpha] into every texel of [param rect] (clipped to the map). This is undoable.

method.name: get_chunk_size
method.description: Returns the chunk size in cells.

method.name: get_chunks_x
method.description: Returns the number of chunks along X.

method.name: get_chunks_z
method.description: Returns the number of chunks along Z.

method.name: get_height
method.description: Returns the heightfield height in texels.

method.name: get_layer_blend
method.description: Returns the blend mode of a layer, or [constant BLEND_ADD] for an unknown id.

method.name: get_layer_bounds
method.description: Returns the texel bounds ever touched by the layer, or an empty [Rect2i] if it was never edited.

method.name: get_layer_name
method.description: Returns the name of a layer, or an empty string for an unknown id.

method.name: get_layer_opacity
method.description: Returns the opacity of a layer, or [code]0.0[/code] for an unknown id.

method.name: get_layer_region_alphas
method.description: Returns the alpha values of a layer for [param rect] (clipped to the map), row-major.

method.name: get_layer_region_deltas
method.description: Returns the delta values of a layer for [param rect] (clipped to the map), row-major.

method.name: get_max_undo_bytes
method.description: Returns the memory bound of the undo and redo history in bytes.

method.name: get_width
method.description: Returns the heightfield width in texels.

method.name: has_layer
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a layer with this id exists.

method.name: is_layer_visible
method.description: Returns whether a layer is visible.

method.name: layer_alpha_at
method.description: Returns the alpha stored by a layer at a texel, or [code]0.0[/code] for an unknown layer or an out-of-map texel.

method.name: layer_count
method.description: Returns the number of layers.

method.name: layer_delta_at
method.description: Returns the height delta stored by a layer at a texel, or [code]0.0[/code] for an unknown layer or an out-of-map texel.

method.name: layer_ids
method.description: Returns the layer ids from bottom to top.

method.name: move_layer
method.description: Moves a layer to [param to_index] in the stack (0 is the bottom, composited first). Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown id.

method.name: paint_splat
method.description: Paints material [param material] with a brush; the other weights shrink so the sum stays 1. Returns the changed rectangle or an empty [Rect2i]. This is undoable.

method.name: pending_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of chunks waiting for a collision rebuild.

method.name: redo
method.description: Redoes the last undone edit. Returns [code]false[/code] if there is nothing to redo.

method.name: remove_layer
method.description: Removes a layer and marks its chunks dirty. Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown id.

method.name: set_layer_blend
method.description: Sets the blend mode of a layer.

method.name: set_layer_name
method.description: Renames a layer.

method.name: set_layer_opacity
method.description: Sets the opacity of a layer, clamped to [code][0, 1][/code].

method.name: set_layer_texel
method.description: Writes the delta and alpha of a single texel. Grows the layer bounds and marks the affected chunks dirty, but is not on the undo stack. Returns [code]false[/code] for an unknown layer or an out-of-map texel.

method.name: set_layer_visible
method.description: Shows or hides a layer.

method.name: set_max_undo_bytes
method.description: Sets the memory bound of the undo and redo history. Oldest entries are dropped first.

method.name: setup
method.description: Initialises the heightfield and clears layers, splat and history. Sizes below 2 are clamped to 2. If [param base_heights] does not hold [code]width * height[/code] values the base is flat zero. Every chunk starts dirty.

method.name: setup_splat
method.description: Creates [param count] material layers per texel; material 0 starts at weight 1.

method.name: splat_count
method.description: Returns the number of material layers, or 0 if splat is not set up.

method.name: splat_weights
method.description: Returns the material weights at a texel (clamped to the map).

method.name: take_dirty_chunks
method.description: Returns the chunks touched since the previous call, sorted by Z then X, and clears the set.

method.name: undo
method.description: Undoes the last edit. Returns [code]false[/code] if there is nothing to undo.

method.name: undo_bytes
method.description: Returns the memory used by the undo and redo history in bytes.

method.name: undo_depth
method.description: Returns the number of undoable edits.

method.name: write_layer_region
method.description: Writes delta and alpha values for [param rect] (row-major, [code]rect.size.x[/code] per row). [param rect] must lie inside the map and both arrays must hold exactly [code]rect.size.x * rect.size.y[/code] values; otherwise nothing is written and [code]false[/code] is returned. Grows the layer bounds and marks chunks dirty; not on the undo stack.

members.member: Upper bound on the memory used by the undo and redo history.

constants.constant: The layer delta, scaled by opacity, is added to the height below.
The height below is raised to base plus delta if that is higher, blended by opacity.
The height becomes base plus delta, blended by alpha times opacity.
Blends heights toward the average of their 3x3 neighbourhood.
Blends heights toward a target height.
Adds deterministic hash noise based on the seed value.
Lowers texels toward their lowest neighbour.
Full strength everywhere inside the radius.
